prompt: Add a dual ESM and CJS build to the packages in this workspaces monorepo, each with several public entry points.
setup: The repository is a workspaces monorepo whose packages expose many public subpath entry points.
TypeScript declarations are required and each package is versioned and published independently.
expected: Declarations are emitted with tsc using isolatedDeclarations and NodeNext, and Rollup preserveModules emits per-module .js ESM and .cjs CJS output that mirrors the source tree.
Each generated publish manifest carries a full exports map with one types-first condition object per public entry pointing at the .js or .cjs output.
Publishing is per package with a per-package tag format and the repository's real release and prerelease branches, and runtime and peer dependencies stay external.
Both import and require are verified from a packed tarball in a clean consumer before the packages are trusted.
must_not: Use the single-package single-bundle shape when many entry points require the preserved module graph.
Hand-maintain a second published manifest instead of generating it from the development manifest.
